evals.prompt: Our support agent's triage step sends refund requests to the general queue. Make it route them to a new billing queue.
expectations: Before changing code, the agent adds capability eval cases for refund tickets (expecting billing) and keeps the existing cases as the regression eval
The agent runs the evals before the change and shows the refund cases failing (the baseline failure)
The agent changes the routing (a billing route for refund/charge wording) without breaking the security, shipping and general cases
The agent re-runs the evals after the change and reports the before/after difference (e.g. passed counts)
